scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.windows:tauri:run: set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%&& pnpm.cmd --dir windows-tauri --ignore-workspace exec tauri dev
scripts.windows:tauri:build:internal: pnpm.cmd windows:tauri:prepare && set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%&& pnpm.cmd --dir windows-tauri --ignore-workspace exec tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.internal.conf.json
scripts.windows:tauri:build:signed: pnpm.cmd windows:tauri:signing:preflight && pnpm.cmd windows:tauri:prepare && set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%&& pnpm.cmd --dir windows-tauri --ignore-workspace exec tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.authenticode.conf.json && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File scripts/windows-authenticode.ps1 -Mode VerifyBundle -Path windows-tauri/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/auth-anti-abuse-smoke.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.format:check: biome format package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/auth-anti-abuse-smoke.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check package.json biome.json playwright.config.ts tests/e2e tests/rls tests/security scripts/supabase-typegen.mjs scripts/rls-smoke.mjs scripts/rls-anon-rest-probe.mjs scripts/auth-anti-abuse-smoke.mjs scripts/e2e-auth-states.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/rateLimit.mjs supabase/functions/auth-yandex-gateway/inviteCode.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
